entries.claim: Relative registry derivative of current-induced layer-odd out-of-plane spin in a mirror-exchanging bilayer has a nontrivial and nonzero measurable coefficient
entries.reason: The symmetry invariant is allowed in the idealized C3z+mx+mz family, but the published LEE Eq.(3) k.p model has an exactly in-plane spin-helicity structure and gives <tau_z sigma_z>=0 for every k, Delta and scalar t_perp. The proposed S_-^z slide derivative therefore cannot be tested in Eq.(3) by changing scalar parameters. Need a source-backed model with both spin-z matrix elements and microscopic registry-dependent H(u); original 2026 LEE SM equation-level overlap remains to be checked.

novelty_decision_scope: Every NO_GO_CLAIM applies ONLY to the precisely recorded general claim, never the entire research direction. Literature role (direct vs introduction) is relative to a specified source/observable/protocol claim and cannot be assigned globally by keyword similarity.

literature_role_policy.CONFIRMED_DIRECT: Same asserted physical observable, source/drive, response regime and crucial conclusion, supported by source-level paper comparison; only that overlapping claim is pre-empted
literature_role_policy.POTENTIAL_DIRECT: Same or nearby operator/drive; supplemental formula and boundary/transport conditions need checking before declaring priority overlap
literature_role_policy.INTRODUCTION_CONTEXT: Establishes field/method/material motivation but not an equivalent result for the exact candidate claim
literature_role_policy.IRRELEVANT_TO_CLAIM: Topical overlap insufficient for citation in this specific paper
